source.publisher: State of Oklahoma, Office of Management and Enterprise Services

scope: Real public-sector posted totals (USD fund accounting); not an enterprise ledger, not CAS/SCAS.
findings: The file is cp1252, not UTF-8; a UTF-8-only importer would fail on real public data.
20 posted totals carry more than two decimals; money() rejects them instead of rounding silently.
All 373,337 accepted amounts parse identically under an independent Decimal parse.

The extract contains asset (mostly cash), revenue and expenditure classes but no liability or fund-balance accounts, so double-entry balance cannot be tested on it; the 382 non-zero groups reflect extract coverage, not errors in the State ledger.
limitations: One quarter (FY24 Q4) of one public-sector ledger; USD fund accounting, not CAS/SCAS or a company.
The product CNY import was not used; only its money() parser ran on these amounts.
No anomaly truth exists for this data; no detection accuracy is claimed.
